name: Angel!
source:
Hero is an angel apprentice who can not pass the promotion test to angels even though his lover Shirley is already an angel. The chief angel chief decided to impose the final special examination on the hero. Its contents is to go down to the Earth, do good things and earn 100 points in 6 days. If those conditions aren't met the hero will be expelled from the Heavens forever. His powers on Earth are limited to transformation into a strange stuffed animal figure. He appoints two school girls Mikoto and Makoto as his own apprentices and hurries to do the good deeds worth 100 points.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄是一名天使学徒，尽管他的爱人雪莉已经是天使，但他却无法通过天使晋升考试。首席天使长决定对英雄进行最后的特殊检查。其内容是深入地球，做好事，6天赚100积分。如果不满足这些条件，英雄将被永远驱逐出天堂。他在地球上的能力仅限于变成一个奇怪的毛绒动物人物。他收了两名女学生美琴和真琴为自己的徒弟，并赶紧去做价值100分的善事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
